episodes.synopsis: Nanako has her first day at Seiran Academy.
episodes.title: The Magnificent Ones

episodes.synopsis: Mariko looks out for Nanako before class, and shoves Tomoko out of the way when she finds Nanako. Fukiko comes to Nanako's class and announces three Sorority candidates.
episodes.title: The Glass Slippers

episodes.synopsis: An insulting note is posted about Nanako's candidacy for the Sorority on the school bulletin board.
episodes.title: Nanako, Disqualified?

episodes.synopsis: Despite missing the selection party, Nanako has her interview, and humiliates herself.
episodes.title: The Music Box

episodes.synopsis: Nanako sees Kaoru stop Rei from taking some pills.
episodes.title: Thorns of Suspicion and Doubt

episodes.synopsis: The bullying continues. Nanako's gym uniform is stolen and cut to shreds, and Tomoko won't lend Nanako hers.
episodes.title: Lost and Alone

episodes.synopsis: Depressed from her classmates' bullying, Nanako goes to the school's clock tower to spend some time alone.
episodes.title: The Darkness in the Clock Tower

episodes.synopsis: Mariko tries to warn Tomoko off Nanako again, but Kaoru comes by and stops her.
episodes.title: I Want You

episodes.synopsis: Kaoru collapses from chest pains, so Nanako tries to fetch painkillers from Rei.
episodes.title: Relapse, Broken Heart

episodes.synopsis: Mariko refuses to eat anything until Nanako forgives her, but Nanako is giving her the silent treatment.
episodes.title: Mariko...

episodes.synopsis: The Sorority members have a special study session at Fukiko's house.
episodes.title: Under the Elm Tree...

episodes.synopsis: Nanako calls Kaoru to help take care of Rei.
episodes.title: The Scar

episodes.synopsis: Rei is well enough to go back to school. She confronts Fukiko, but is made docile with a few words.
episodes.title: A Tale of Double Suicide

episodes.synopsis: Nanako desperately tries to escape from Rei, but fails.
episodes.title: The Secret Door

episodes.synopsis: A Sorority member named Junko Nakaya fails one of her exams due to having been seriously ill, so Fukiko orders her to resign.
episodes.title: Fukiko, the Sea Rumbles

episodes.synopsis: It is Kaoru's first basketball game since her illness, and she is determined to win.
episodes.title: Comeback

episodes.synopsis: Nanako realizes that she has fallen in love with Rei, but is too nervous to say anything.
episodes.title: Postscript

episodes.synopsis: After Nanako accidentally misses her bus stop, Rei takes her to the park.
episodes.title: Into the Dream

episodes.synopsis: Rei refuses to react after hearing Nanako's confession and begins to intentionally avoid her, breaking Nanako's heart.
episodes.title: The Transient Game

episodes.synopsis: Nanako and Tomoko decide to go to Takehiko's university fair.
episodes.title: The Gardening Shears

episodes.synopsis: Nanako, Tomoko, and Mariko go the University Fair with Takehiko and Takashi, Fukiko's older brother.
episodes.title: The University Festival

episodes.synopsis: Mariko and Nanako are invited by Fukiko to her country house for the weekend to help her prepare for her birthday party.
episodes.title: A Summer Day's Serenade

episodes.synopsis: Home from the lake house, Fukiko and Rei visit Ms. Asaka's grave on the anniversary of her death, three years ago.
episodes.title: The Forbidden Gift

episodes.synopsis: Confused by the events of the party, Rei inquires of Takashi as to why the song upset Fukiko.
episodes.title: Encore

episodes.synopsis: Rei reminisces about the first time she met Fukiko, remembering how, even as a child, her pride had still been admirable.
episodes.title: The Scarlet Lipstick

episodes.synopsis: Rei reflects on that double suicide pact that she and Fukiko made shortly after Rei's mother committed suicide.
episodes.title: Proof: Snow for the Two of Us Alone

episodes.synopsis: Mariko's parents are divorcing and she is traumatized, spending the night at Nanako's home to try coping.
episodes.title: Mariko's Incident of Bloodshed

episodes.synopsis: Everyone desperately looks for the missing Mariko, fearing for the worst.
episodes.title: The Christmas Candles

episodes.synopsis: At the Student Assembly, Kaoru asks for the abolition of the Sorority.
episodes.title: The Student Assembly

episodes.synopsis: Two Sorority members, Ogiwara and Komabayashi, persuade Aya's friends, Miyuki and Megumi, to steal and burn the petitions.
episodes.title: The Petition

episodes.synopsis: The Sorority members are getting scared as the Petition gains movement and their own members begin signing it.
episodes.title: The Bad Apple

episodes.synopsis: Fukiko continues to pretend that nothing is wrong.
episodes.title: Pride: The Last Meeting

episodes.synopsis: Rei dreams of her mother's death, in which Ms. Asaka reveals that Fukiko is her child as well.
episodes.title: Soaring

episodes.synopsis: Nanako waits for Rei to pick her up for their date, but soon, everyone finds out about Rei.
episodes.title: Ablution

episodes.synopsis: The school attends Rei's funeral. Fukiko accepts all of the guests with dignity.
episodes.title: The Shore of Dreams

episodes.synopsis: Two weeks after Rei dies, it is the summer holidays.
episodes.title: Fireflies, Burning with Love...

episodes.synopsis: Kaoru tells Nanako that she broke up with Takehiko because of her illness and mastectomy, and that Nanako is really Takehiko's stepsister.
episodes.title: Merry-Go-Round

episodes.synopsis: Takehiko is about to leave for Germany, so Kaoru intends to leave him behind for good.
episodes.title: Yes

episodes.synopsis: Fukiko has a hallucination where Rei encourages her to find true love.
episodes.title: A Lingering Fragrance
